catalog.purpose: End-to-end SQL interpreter, B-tree, memory, branch and storage-independent compiler workload coverage.
qualification_gaps: The proprietary TH3 suite is not part of the public source archive.
Declare in-memory versus filesystem tests and separate SQLite result validation from filesystem noise.
Versioned SQL scripts, schema/data generators, PRAGMA settings and database bytes require independent locks.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: SQLite canonical source and tests

activation: Use cpg packages info sqlite and paths sqlite to select the intended installation. The host Python sqlite3 module may link another SQLite version and is not this resource.
Optionally add <prefix>/bin to PATH and <prefix>/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH; use explicit library paths when compiling applications. No daemon or database initialization is required.

examples.command: cpg packages info sqlite --json; cpg packages paths sqlite; cpg packages check sqlite --prefix <prefix>
examples.description: Inspect the exact selected version and functionality

examples.command: <prefix>/bin/sqlite3 -batch experiment.db "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, score REAL); PRAGMA integrity_check;"
examples.description: Create a database and verify its structure
Use WAL and JSON SQL explicitly

examples.command: cpg packages pack packages/sqlite/package.json --definition --method source --source sqlite=/path/to/locked-archive --recipe packages/sqlite/recipe --output sqlite.source.cpgpkg.tar.gz
cpg packages pack packages/sqlite/material-profile.json --definition --method material --payload /path/to/verified-unpacked-source --output sqlite.material.cpgpkg.tar.gz
examples.description: Pack the same ID with every original raw material file

examples.command: cpg packages pack packages/sqlite/package.json --definition --method binary --payload <checked-prefix> --recipe packages/sqlite/recipe --relocatable --output sqlite.binary.cpgpkg.tar.gz
examples.description: Pack a checked installation for independent same-target prefixes

notes: package.json adds explicit source/binary profiles; material-profile.json preserves the original same-ID definition byte for byte. Both are directly usable with pack --definition. Full source locks and metadata.catalog remain unchanged.

Native target: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, exact existing apt.build-essential=12.10ubuntu1 build and apt.python3=3.12.3-0ubuntu2.1 check prerequisites. No APT transaction is performed by this recipe; the native build environment/tool hashes are recorded separately.

Configuration: --all SQL extensions (including FTS5, RTREE, session, JSON/default math), shared/static C libraries, threadsafe default, loadable extensions, no readline/editline and no full Tcl extension. Bundled Jim Tcl performs canonical code generation.

Explicit no-zlib profile: this pinned upstream configure script has no public disable switch, so the recipe disables its single zlib autodetection branch in a private build copy with an exact-match guard. It does not edit original source assets or raw materials. Compressed ZIP/archive functions requiring zlib are not claimed. All upstream integration source remains available for developer-selected builds with exact extra dependencies.

Before installation the recipe runs upstream make sourcetest and the public fuzzcheck harness against the complete fuzzdata1.db corpus with a fixed PRNG seed and explicit per-case timeout. Full Tcl devtest/releasetest requires separately installed exact apt.tcl/apt.tcl-dev prerequisites and is not_run here. TH3 is separately distributed upstream and is not included or claimed.

Installed functional checks cover shared-library/Fossil identity, prepared statements/blobs, foreign keys, transaction rollback, WAL reader/writer behavior, online backup, FTS5/RTREE/JSON/session, CLI backup/dump/restore, uniqueness failure and a genuinely loaded custom extension.

Original material installs retain every file and report executable checks not_run. Binary relocation only covers fresh independent prefixes on the same declared target; it does not certify all architectures, a complete APT closure, OCI deployment, release testing or benchmark scores.

The official public fuzz harness has its own extra compile-time test flags. Its source qualification supplements, and does not replace, the separately executed installed-library checks. The bundled static archive is available; the functional C API probe selects the shared library.
usage.summary: SQLite 3.54.1 canonical-source SQL engine: CLI, checked shared C API, static archive, headers, generated amalgamation and loadable-extension example; full original source/test material remains under the same ID.
